style_sentence: Top-down RPG pixel art seen from a low three-quarter view, light from the top left, a 1 px dark navy-violet outline, two or three shades per material, no dithering, transparent background, no text or letters.
height_rule: opaque rows from the top of the head, hair or hood to the lowest sole pixel. On every candidate here the lowest opaque row is a sole row (the player's blade ends on the sole row, never below it), so height = lowest opaque row - top row + 1. Rotations and animation frames are listed with top-to-lowest-opaque-row, which on side views can include the blade tip.
images_passed_as: upload:<id> references from get_upload_url; no inline base64 anywhere
seed: 1234 on both create_image_pro calls; create_character and animate_character take no seed. No retake, so no seed or canvas change was used.

retakes.note: No hard failure: both picks are within 3 px of 45 (player candidates 41-48 with two at 46 and one at 47; Tally 47-49), every candidate faces south except player #19 (back view), none is cut off, all are the right subject.

surprises: Canvas fill is higher than the style sheet predicts: the player filled 48/56 = 86 % of its canvas (sheet: 75-85 % for Kindled) and Tally 48/54 = 89 % (sheet: /0.75 for everyone else). Cutting Tally's canvas by 6 rows (60 -> 54) lowered her typical height by only 2 px (50 -> 48).
Both create_image_pro calls returned 25 candidates (the tool doc says 16 for a 51-64 px larger side; Job 3 got 16 at 44x60).
Every player candidate that keeps the design (blade on the viewer's left, hood, freckles) is 48 px; the 46-47 px ones all drop or move the blade.
Tally's pick is outlined in dream-night #1C2147 (132 of 133 edge pixels), the player-only outline colour; Job 3's Tally used hollow-deep #2A2540. Her freckles are not amber (no #F2B65A).
The walk directions whose rotation came out on-palette (S, NE, N) stayed fully on-palette in all 6 skeleton-v3 frames; SE and E carried the rotation's off-palette colours.
In walk-skel S the blade shortens to a stub in frames 1-2 and lengthens again in 4-5.
